description: This Java class defines a custom UI component 'QuickTextPagerView' for an Android keyboard app, managing quick text keys, themes, and tabbed navigation.

classes.name: QuickTextPagerView
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that provides a tabbed interface for quick text keys, supporting themes, media insertion, and history management.

methods.name: QuickTextPagerView
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the view with context, attribute set, and style.

methods.name: setupSlidingTab
methods.description: Configures the tab strip with the ViewPager and adapter, setting text size, color, and page change listener.

methods.name: setThemeValues
methods.description: Sets theme-related properties such as icons, colors, and supported media types, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: setOnKeyboardActionListener
methods.description: Sets up the keyboard action listener, initializes quick text keys, and configures the ViewPager and tabs.

methods.name: setQuickKeyHistoryRecords
methods.description: Assigns the history records for quick text keys.

methods.name: setEmojiVariantsPrefTrackers
methods.description: Sets the default skin tone and gender preference trackers for emoji variants.
